He remains chief technology officer, overseeing the design of software used by corporate finance teams.

long_biography.plain_text:
Robert Allan “Bob” Powers Jr. helped design a unified finance platform with Tom Shea while they worked in different states, sometimes meeting only once or twice a year. Powers had previously created Hyperion Financial Management, a corporate consolidation product. His experience integrating separate finance tools persuaded him that companies needed one adaptable system rather than another collection of applications.

Powers, Shea and Craig Colby formed OneStream Software and funded its early development themselves. They tested the product with initial customers before widening sales; Powers directed its architecture as the business grew. After KKR invested and the company went public, software investor Hg acquired it in 2026. Powers remains its chief technology officer.
